title: CreateUserRequest
description: Parameters for creating a managed user in the organization.

email.description:
The email address of the user. The email domain must be a verified domain owned by the
caller's organization.

display_name.description: The display name of the user.

first_name.description: The first name of the user.

last_name.description: The last name of the user.

locale.description: The locale of the user, as an IETF BCP 47 language tag. Must be a supported language. Defaults to `en` if not provided.

team_memberships.description: The teams the user is added to. At least one team membership is required so that the user is visible in the [Get user](https://www.canva.dev/docs/admin/api-reference/users/get-user/) and [List users](https://www.canva.dev/docs/admin/api-reference/users/list-users/) API responses.

SamlAccount.description: The SAML account details used to link the user to the organization's identity provider for SSO.

idp_issuer.description: The issuer id or entity id of the SAML identity provider. Often a unique URL, but not always. Must resolve to an identity provider owned by the caller's organization.

name_id.description: The SAML NameID that identifies the user to the identity provider. This value is case sensitive, and shouldn't change.

TeamMemberRole.description: The role of the member in the team.

TeamMembership.description: A team to add the user to on creation, with the user's role in that team.
